invam2.reason: Not a reflex bow: the line is defined by broad limbs whose ends recurve away from the string; the guide curls the tips back toward the string into small rings, the model followed it, and all four seeds are a plain deep D that reads like the long bow at 34 px, the rings lost at 1x.

fix.desc: A huntress's tall recurve bow: from the grip each limb sweeps out in a deep curve and then, in its last fifth, bends back the other way, away from the string, so both ends recurve like the crest of a wave and the string lies along each recurved end before it reaches the tip; the limbs broad near the grip and slimming toward the ends, of amber-brown horn laminated over pale wood with a thin dark seam between them; small carved bone caps on the tips; a carved wooden grip wrapped in braided cord with a small leather arrow pad. A recurved outline whose ends flick outward, not a plain D. Shown upright, side view, the string on the left, the bow arching to the right.
fix.guide_new: box/guides.py: a recurve-bow entry on 704x1408 in place of reflex-bow (whose tips curl the wrong way): a tall deep D (depth about a third of the height), the limbs about twice long-bow's width beside the grip and slimming outward; in each limb's last fifth the curve reverses so the tip points out to the right, away from the string; the string straight on the left between the two points where the curves reverse, then lying along each recurved end to its tip.
fix.shape: recurve-bow: a tall deep D with broad limbs whose last fifth reverses so each tip points out to the right; the string straight between the reversal points, then along the recurved ends
fix.note: our 双曲弓 line (the huntress's Reflex / Ceremonial / Grand Matron Bow): the line's defining part is recurved ends on broad limbs; own design: amber horn on pale wood, bone tip caps, a braided grip (review round 1: reflex-bow's tips curled toward the string into rings and the bow read as a plain D)

invcqv.reason: Too near the original's own design and weak as bolts: a tapered box quiver of hairy brown hide is the original's particular choice (outline and material; 0.40 and 0.42 on s202/s303, the group's highest, edges lined up along the whole box), and the rounded heads read as a cup of pencils at 1x.

fix.desc: A bolt case for crossbow bolts: a straight-sided square box of dark stained oak boards, open at the top and as wide at the bottom as at the mouth, its four corners bound with riveted iron angle straps and a broad iron band round the mouth, a leather carrying strap hanging in a loop from two iron rings on one side; standing in it about a dozen short thick crossbow bolts point up, each with a heavy dark iron head shaped like a small four-sided pyramid with a flared collar at the shaft, the heads sharp-edged and clearly pointed, not rounded; no fur, no hair, no hide. Shown upright, front view, the open end at the top.
fix.guide_new: box/guides.py: a bolt-case entry on 512x1536: a straight-sided upright rectangle (about 0.6 of the width, the lower two thirds of the height) with a darker band at its mouth and thin corner straps, and above it a row of about eight short shafts ending in small pointed pyramid heads, staggered in height; our own generic shape.
fix.shape: bolt-case: a straight-sided box, not tapered, banded at the mouth, a staggered row of short pointed bolt heads above it
fix.note: our 弩矢 (Bolts): own design, an iron-bound oak case with the heads up, told from the round leather arrow quiver (review round 1: the tapered hairy-hide quiver was too near the original's design and its heads read as pencils)

invhbw.reason: Not this line: the hunter's bow is defined by a stave cut from a crooked, wavy branch; ours came out a smooth two-tone D whose limbs are hardly broader than the short bow's, so the 猎弓 line looks like a pale short bow at 34 px. s303 and s404 also paint a stray diagonal string across the bow.

fix.desc: A hunter's bow made from a single crooked branch: the two limbs are not smooth arcs but wander in three or four gentle, irregular bends along their length like a knotty stick, the bark stripped to weathered grey-brown wood with dark knots and two or three short stubs of trimmed twigs, a grip of rawhide strips wound round the middle, both tips cut into simple notches and bound with dark sinew, a thin pale twine string running perfectly straight from tip to tip and nothing else crossing the bow. A D whose curved side wobbles like a crooked stick, not a smooth curve. Shown upright, side view, the string on the left, the bow arching to the right.
fix.guide_new: box/guides.py: a crooked-bow entry on 832x1248 (the short-bow family with a wobble): short-bow's D, its limb band about 1.3 times short-bow's width, displaced along the arc's normal by three gentle waves a limb (amplitude about one limb width, the two limbs out of phase so it never mirrors), a short grip block at the middle, small notched tips, the string straight on the left. Our own parametric shape, not traced.
fix.shape: crooked-bow: short-bow's D whose limbs wobble in three irregular waves each, the two limbs out of phase; a short grip block at the middle; the string straight on the left
fix.note: our 猎弓 line (Hunter's / Razor / Blade Bow): the line's defining part is a stave cut from a crooked branch; own design: grey-brown stripped wood, twig stubs, rawhide grip (review round 1: the two-tone flat bow did not read as this line)

invlbb.reason: As invsbb, made long: the B outline carries none of the battle bows' broad horn-faced limbs, and the two humps read as a letter B at 2x4.

fix.desc: A tall long battle bow whose two long limbs are faced with broad flat plates of dark ox horn, blackish brown with streaks of translucent amber, each plate as wide as three fingers beside the grip and narrowing to a point two thirds of the way to the tip, fixed to the wooden core with small iron rivets; a long grip of dark leather bound with iron wire; long bare wooden tips bound with sinew, curving slightly forward away from the string; a straight pale string. A tall D with broad blade-like limbs, clearly wider than a plain stave. Shown upright, side view, the string on the left, the bow arching to the right.
fix.guide_new: box/guides.py: a long-plated-bow entry on 704x1408: the plated bow as a tall shallow D (depth about a fifth of the height), each limb a broad plate tapering to a point two thirds of the way out, then a long thin bare tip turning a little right; the string straight on the left.
fix.shape: the plated bow on the 2x4 canvas: a tall shallow D, broad plates tapering two thirds of the way out, long thin tips turning a little right; the string straight on the left
fix.note: our 长战弓 line (Long Battle / Large Siege / Crusader Bow): invsbb's horn-plated limbs made long (review round 1: the B outline went with invsbb's)

invopl.reason: Reads as a healing potion: the dark amber oil came out red-brown, and a round flask of red liquid at 34 px is the light/plain healing flask (invhp2, invhp3); the rag wick is too small to tell it apart at 1x.

fix.desc: A fire bottle for throwing: a small round-bellied flask of thick clear glass with a short neck, filled to the shoulder with pale golden lamp oil, light straw-yellow like clear cooking oil, never red or brown; a thick twist of oily grey rag stuffed into the neck as a wick, a tuft of it sticking up above the neck and a frayed tail hanging down one side of the flask, tied round the neck with twine. Shown upright.
fix.note: Oil Potion (ops, our 火油药水): the fire line's smallest, the same round flask as invgpl's pick with a rag wick; the oil must read yellow, apart from the scarlet healing flasks (review round 1: dark amber came out red-brown and read as a healing potion at 34 px)

invsbb.reason: Not this line: the battle bows are defined by broad, flat horn-faced limbs; our double-curved B is an invented outline with thin round limbs, so nothing of the line's defining part shows, and the B reads oddly as a letter at 2x3.

fix.desc: A short battle bow whose two limbs are faced with broad flat plates of dark ox horn, blackish brown with streaks of translucent amber, each plate as wide as three fingers beside the grip and narrowing to a point near the tip like a long leaf, fixed to the wooden core with two small iron rivets; a thick grip of dark leather bound with iron wire between the two plates; short bare wooden tips bound with sinew, curving slightly forward away from the string; a straight pale string. A D with broad blade-like limbs, clearly wider than a plain stave. Shown upright, side view, the string on the left, the bow arching to the right.
fix.guide_new: box/guides.py: a plated-bow entry on 832x1248 replacing battle-bow for this picture: short-bow's D; from the grip block each limb a broad flat plate about three times short-bow's limb width, tapering to a point three quarters of the way to the tip, then a thin bare tip turning a little to the right (away from the string); the string straight on the left.
fix.shape: plated-bow: short-bow's D with each limb a broad flat plate tapering to a point three quarters of the way out, then a thin bare tip turning a little right; the string straight on the left
fix.note: our 短战弓 line (Short Battle / Short Siege / Diamond Bow): the line's defining part is broad horn-faced limbs; own design: dark ox horn with amber streaks, riveted, an iron-wire grip (review round 1: the double-curved B outline was not this line's)
